description: Count the number of Huawei Cloud GaussDB instances in a region and output the count. Covers both GaussDB for openGauss and GaussDB (MySQL-compatible) instances. Returns the authoritative total_count from the list API, so the reported number is always correct. Read-only — never creates, modifies or deletes any resource. Use for GaussDB database inventory, daily inspection, or cost review. Triggers include: count GaussDB, GaussDB count, GaussDB instance count, how many GaussDB instances, GaussDB数量, GaussDB实例数量, 查询GaussDB数量, GaussDB总数, 统计GaussDB实例数.
